messages:
elena: FYI rolled the adaptive-quant + kernel-selector change into a small canary (g4x, 12% traffic) this morning. preliminary: cost/token down ~18%, p50 -28ms for short prompts.

marc: nice. is this the int4->int8 dynamic fallback path? any p99 regressions?

elena: yes. runtime now picks int4 fast-path for sequences <64 tokens and switches to int8 kernels when activation norms exceed threshold. p99 increased ~4% on the canary but stays within SLO. p95 unchanged.

rob: what's driving the p99 bump? cache thrash or kernel overhead?

elena: mostly occasional kernel-switch overhead on bursts that cross the threshold mid-request. added a micro-batch coalescer to amortize the switch; should smooth it.

tay: can you paste the kernel selector config? want to run local sims.

elena: pasted below, it's lightweight.

```
{
  "kernel_selector": {
    "fast_path": "int4",
    "fallback": "int8",
    "seq_threshold": "64",
    "norm_threshold": "2.4",
    "switch_cooldown_ms": "150",
    "batch_coalesce_ms": "6"
  }
}
```

elena: infra-bot shows applied ok. will keep at 12% for 48h and run eval suites. if p99 > +10% we auto-rollback.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy 1970000000: applied to pool g4x-canary-7 12% traffic. health checks: OK. cost/token: -18%. p50: -28ms. p95: +0%. p99: +4%.

marc: any impact on memory/GPU utilization? we use tighter workspace with int4 so memory dropped ~9% which freed headroom for extra microbatches.

rob: do we need changes in the quantization profiles for certain models? saw one model with noisy activation norms.

elena: good call. added model-exemption list for older decoder-only models; they stay on int8 path. we only enable fast-path for verified model ids.

tay: can you share smoke evals when they're in? want to check hallucination/regression matrix.

elena: will post a short summary tomorrow with graphs. early smoke: generation-regression 0.1% better, rerank: +0.2% stable.

marc: awesome win. if canary stays healthy, let's plan 50% rollout by EOD Thu. please add a short blurb for eng-all-hands.

elena: will do. tagging @product for visibility. thanks team!
